source_chain_oracle.open_semantic_mint_boundary: Canonical ProgramSemanticId should be derived at deterministic canonical typed IR or equivalently verified canonical semantic stage; Source/Parse stages must not independently mint semantic authority.

resource_aba_rule: A reusable backend slot/index is never sufficient live-resource identity after close/drop/reuse. A stale handle must fail closed through generation/lifetime identity or an equivalently verified backend-native mechanism.
parser_rule: Grammar syntax identity and parser operational semantics identity are separate. Differential equivalence fails when parser_semantics_hash differs even if final runtime state matches.
semantic_id_rule: Pre-canonical stages carry source/parse/expected-semantic evidence. Canonical ProgramSemanticId authority belongs to deterministic canonical typed IR or an equivalently verified canonical semantic stage and must be derivation-bound to prior artifacts/contracts.
release_equivalence_requires: baseline transaction compatibility or explicit tested divergence
conditional live resource lifetime/type/ownership identity equivalence
authority_rule: No trace, parser, semantic id, model output, graph activation, GWT state, resource descriptor or replay result grants effect authority by representation alone.
